integrity: Proof and characteristic-free orbit computation are included, with a standalone standard-library finite-field verifier. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only Poisson brackets on the fixed ten-dimensional cube-zero commutative local algebra with prescribed Heisenberg first jet; quotient only by algebra automorphisms inducing the identity on the first-order space. No full unframed classification and no higher-jet liftability result.
title: Seven-parameter normal forms for Heisenberg Poisson two-jets
